systems.country_label: Rapidpro: collecte des données sur l'état civil des enfants

note: One row of the plan's inventory of e-health tools: RapidPro, used to collect data on children's civil status, Direction Nationale de l'Etat Civil, 53 cercles. The row does not say whether the tool registers a birth, notifies one or counts them, so no class and no fact.
